subject: Noesis renewal: quantified impact endorsement & procurement pack request
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@noesis.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Torres <lina.torres@noesis.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal prep: procurement pack & outcome numbers

Hi Stephanie / Jordan —

We're kicking off procurement for our renewal (renewal date Aug 15). Procurement has asked for a concise evidence pack showing the value Redwood delivered over our past 12 months so we can justify the renewal and the proposed seat increase. Specifically they want: 
- A one-page exec summary with top-line outcomes (cost savings, latency improvements, availability/SLA performance)
- A short appendix with anonymized usage & ROI numbers (tokens/month, cost per 1M tokens before/after optimizations, estimated savings)
- Any customer quotes or CS-written outcomes we can include for the procurement packet

Can you share a draft by EOD next Wednesday (Jun 30)? We have a procurement review on Jul 7 and it would help to have something for them before that meeting. If there's a better timeline, let me know.

Also copying procurement@noesis.ai — they may have a template.

Thanks,
Amit
Head of Platform — Noesis
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@noesis.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:02:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal prep: procurement pack & outcome numbers

Thanks Amit — we can do that. Plan below: 

1) Executive one-pager (Stephanie) — 1 page, top-line metrics + 2 short bullets on how they were achieved (cache + dedicated pools).
2) Appendix (Jordan) — raw metrics and calculations (tokens/month, cost per 1M tokens, quantized inference delta, SLA uptimes). Jordan, can you assemble the spreadsheet with month-by-month numbers and a short method note?
3) Customer quote (Marissa) — Marissa, can you reach out to Lina for a 1-2 sentence endorsement we can place on the first page? If you want, use the wording: “Redwood cut our inference costs by X% while improving 95th percentile latency by Y ms.”
4) Legal / SLA evidence (Vivek) — Vivek, we should include the signed SLA addendum and the summary of uptime for the past 12 months.

Deliverable deadline: Jun 30 EOD PDT. If any of you foresee blockers, call me and we’ll adjust. Once we have the one-pager and appendix I’ll consolidate and send to Amit / procurement.

Attachments to follow from Jordan & Vivek.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 08:45:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal prep: procurement pack & outcome numbers

Hi folks — attaching the appendix draft with the month-by-month metrics and calc sheet. Top-line numbers below (rounded):

- 12-mo token volume: 1.8B tokens
- Avg cost per 1M tokens (before optimizations): $58.2
- Avg cost per 1M tokens (after batch + quantization): $22.7
- Estimated gross savings: ~61% on inference unit costs (savings realized via smarter batching + switching certain workloads to Dedicated pools)
- 95th pct latency improvement: from ~420ms to ~210ms for API calls behind the Dedicated pool routing
- Uptime (last 12 months): 99.96% (see SLA dashboard snapshot tab)

Notes: numbers in the sheet include the method tab that explains how we normalized for request size and prompt length. Also included a short section on what changed (prefix KV caching + model variant routing) so procurement understands these are operational improvements, not feature skews.

[Attachment: Noesis_Q2_Impact_Metrics.xlsx (XLSX)]

Jordan

Thanks team — this looks good. I reviewed the appendix and the exec brief draft Stephanie is putting together. A couple quick suggestions: 

- Include a one-line customer ROI statement on page 1 (Marissa, if Lina can confirm a 3-6 month payback line that would be ideal).
- Add the signed SLA addendum and call out the uptime figure in the exec bullets.

I've attached a cleaned-up exec brief and the signed SLA addendum we already have on file — feel free to include these verbatim in the packet when you send to procurement. Once Stephanie finalizes the one-pager I can send it over to our procurement contacts and to Amit directly. Recommend a 15-min sync with procurement week of Jul 5 to walk through any method questions.
